[tp-asciidoc-viewer%allow-script,label="tp-datefield"]
========
[script,type="tp/asciidoc"]
----
.Basic usage
======
[tp-datefield%clearable,label="Date",value="2026-09-03"]
====
====
======

.Javascript API
======
[script,type="module"]
====
import "/components/datefield/datefield.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-datefield");
element1.setAttribute("label", "Date");
element1.setAttribute("value", "2026-09-03");
element1.setAttribute("clearable", "");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
====
======

.Inline named field
======
Value: [tp-datefield,value="2026-10-05",placeholder="Enter a value"]#identifier#
